correctness.rationale: For any matrix of total flag-rank weight four, a crossing of rank two forces rank profile (1,2,1) and an invertible central 2x2 block with q^2 free endpoint diagonals. Otherwise exactly four rank-one cuts are occupied; classification by highest nonzero superdiagonal gives five disjoint patterns: four diagonals, one edge plus two outside diagonals, two separated edges, one length-three rank-one pattern plus outside diagonal, and one length-four rank-one pattern. Counts derive by GL(2,q) and explicit determinant/rank-one equations valid over all finite fields. The small-field verifier exhaustively checked six category totals separately for (n,q)=(3,2),(4,2),(5,2),(6,2),(3,3),(4,3),(3,4),(4,4), including a proper extension field.

value.rationale: The radius-four ambient sphere is a natural previously uncomputed next object in the 2026 perfect flag-rank metric program, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice: it is the first layer allowing a rank-two crossing, contributing a distinct GL(2,q) factor absent at radii at most three. The exact polynomial supplies the ball volume needed for finite distance-nine packing conditions and a new explicit binomial divisibility obstruction. It holds for all dimensions n>=3 and every finite field, providing structural and coding-theoretic use beyond an isolated computed table.
